# OpenAI Codex Changelog — captured 2026-05-20

## May 20, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.132.0
Python SDK authentication enhancements: API key login, ChatGPT browser flow, device-code flows.
Text-based workflows accept plain strings.
Resumed automations maintain session context with structured output support.

## May 18, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.131.0
Unified `@` mentions across files, directories, plugins, and skills.
Plugin marketplace CLI commands with version-aware sharing.
Remote environments now support daemon-managed control with runtime enable/disable capabilities and registry-backed configuration.

## May 8, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.130.0 (codex remote-control entrypoint, thread pagination)
## May 7, 2026 — Chrome Extension Launch
